relations: Continuous snowfall drifts diagonally across the dark water and bright snow.
The flowing river current produces ripples and white foam near the snow edge.
The snow mounds, distant bank, and resting leaf persist in identical positions and shapes.
A stationary camera framing highlights falling flakes and moving water as the only active elements.
caption: The video captures a winter riverbank under flat, overcast light, where a dark flowing river fills the upper-left and rounded snow and ice mounds line the lower-right. A snow-covered shoreline of bare trees runs across the top, and a small brown leaf rests undisturbed on one mound at the right. Snow falls continuously, appearing as white streaks and dots that drift downward and slightly diagonally across the dark water and bright snow. The river surface keeps shifting, with ripples and small patches of white foam churning near the snow edge as the current moves. The snow mounds, distant bank, and resting leaf hold identical positions and shapes throughout the view. The framing stays fixed, indicating a stationary camera. No snow accumulation or deformation is visible, leaving the falling flakes and moving water as the only active elements in an otherwise still scene.
